title: 第二十一章 孕育新能力的可能第二十二章 吞噬诡异血手印的能力
slug: 诡异复苏我以诡异打造世界
content_zh:
在看到张威精神梦境之中的情况之后，陆羽也没有迟疑，直接便是调动恐惧之力，迅速笼罩了那股灰黑力量。
“嗡嗡...”
两股相似却又不同的力量接触，瞬间便是展开了一场对抗。
“嗯哼！”
现实之中，张威不由眉头紧皱，发出一阵的闷哼。
两股力量的对抗，可是在他精神梦境之中发生的，他自然不会好受，一阵阵剧烈的疼痛，一股股的眩晕之感，不断的涌入他的脑海。
“坚持一下，很快就好了！”
陆羽宽慰了一声，瞬间加大了力量输出，立即便将精神梦境空间之中的，那股灰黑力量压制，并且快速的吞噬起来。
“呃啊~！”
张威双拳紧握，猛地发出一声压抑的痛苦嘶吼。
痛彻心扉，痛入灵魂...
此时的张威，面色苍白如纸，浑身汗如雨下，若非还有着一丝的清醒意识，他都要奋起反抗了。
当然，可能他就是想要反抗，也反抗不了就是了。
不过此时的陆羽，可是没有功夫理会这些了，他正在不断的吞噬那股灰黑色的诡异力量。
同时，一股奇妙的感觉涌上心头，他的梦境世界，正在以那股灰黑色的诡异力量为根本，孕育着一种新的能力。
感受着梦境世界的变化，陆羽不由心中大喜。
他本来都要以为，自己以后就要成长为虚空恐惧了呢。
没想到，他的梦境世界，竟然能够通过吞噬其他的力量，用来孕育产生新的能力。
也就是说，如果给他足够的时间，足够多的不同力量，他会孕育无穷无尽的能力。
到时候，这个世界之上，又还会有谁是他的对手？什么诡异，什么梦魔，那还不都是翻掌可灭？

不由的，陆羽便是再次加大了吞噬力度，一股股的灰黑诡异力量，被其汲取吞噬。
渐渐的，张威的精神梦境之中，已经没有了灰黑色的诡异力量。
瞬间，张威的精神梦境，便是稳固了许多。
只有在那精神梦境的牢笼之中，依旧有着诡异力量的存在，还在不断侵蚀着锁链牢笼。
不过，随着精神梦境的稳固，一股股玄妙的力量扩散，那只断手的挣扎，也在渐渐变得无力，释放的诡异力量，也在一点点的减弱。
相信再过一段时间，张威便可以将其重新镇压了。
不过...
好人做到底，既然来了，那就帮他一次性解决了吧。
恐惧之力瞬间涌动，向着精神梦境中央的牢笼扑去。
伴随着一道道诡异力量被吞噬，那显得腐朽的牢笼锁链，正在渐渐恢复原貌，尽是精铁铸造，更是精纯坚韧的信念意志演化。
最终，那断手散发出来的所有诡异力量，全都被陆羽吞噬一空。
而那被锁链束缚的断手，此时也已经彻底沉寂了下去，若非隐隐透出一抹虚幻之感，还真以为它就是一只普通的断手呢。
“嗯~?！”
看着那只断手如今的模样，陆羽心中有些讪讪，他是不是吸的有些太狠了？
不过不管怎么说，他都是将那只诡异断手的复苏，给彻底压制下去了不是。
陆羽心念一动，那没入张威体内、精神梦境的恐惧之力，便是瞬间回缩，没入了他的梦境世界。
而陆羽也是瞬间收回了心神。
只是一瞬间，除了那一枚恐惧印记，陆羽便将自己的力量，尽数了收回来。
看了看面前精神恍惚，不知所以的张威，陆羽的嘴角扯了扯。
他也不知道，张威如此模样，是因为剥离诡异断手的诡异力量太过痛苦，还是因为他抽取诡异力量太过的缘故。
content_en:
After seeing the situation in Zhang Wei's mental dream, Lu Yu did not hesitate and directly mobilized the power of fear to quickly envelope the gray and black power.
"Buzzing..."
When two similar but different forces came into contact, a confrontation began in an instant.
"Uh-huh!"
In reality, Zhang Wei couldn't help but frown and let out a muffled groan.
The confrontation between the two forces took place in his mental dream, so he naturally didn't feel comfortable. Waves of severe pain and waves of dizziness kept pouring into his mind.
"Hold on, it'll be fine soon!"
Lu Yu let out a sigh of relief and instantly increased his power output. He immediately suppressed the gray-black power in the mental dream space and quickly swallowed it up.
"Uh-huh~!"
Zhang Wei clenched his fists and let out a suppressed roar of pain.
It hurts my heart, hurts my soul...
At this time, Zhang Wei's face was as pale as paper, and he was covered in sweat. If he didn't have a trace of consciousness, he would have fought back.
Of course, maybe he just couldn't resist even if he wanted to.
But at this time, Lu Yu had no time to pay attention to this. He was constantly devouring that gray-black strange power.
At the same time, a strange feeling came to his mind. His dream world was giving birth to a new ability based on that strange gray-black power.
Feeling the changes in the dream world, Lu Yu couldn't help but feel overjoyed.
He originally thought that he would grow into fear of the void in the future.
Unexpectedly, his dream world could be used to breed new abilities by swallowing other powers.
In other words, if you give him enough time and enough different powers, he will give birth to endless abilities.
By then, who else will be his opponent in this world? What kind of weirdness, what kind of dream demon, can’t they all be destroyed with the flip of a palm?
Involuntarily, Lu Yu increased his devouring force again, and streams of gray and black strange power were absorbed and devoured by it.
Gradually, the strange gray-black power disappeared from Zhang Wei's mental dream.
In an instant, Zhang Wei's mental dream became much more stable.
Only in the cage of the spiritual dream, there is still the existence of strange power, which is still eroding the chain cage.
However, as the spiritual dream became more stable, waves of mysterious power spread, and the struggle of the severed hand gradually became weak, and the strange power released also weakened little by little.
I believe that after a while, Zhang Wei will be able to suppress it again.
But...
A good person will fight to the end. Now that he's here, let's help him solve it once and for all.
The power of fear surged instantly and rushed towards the cage in the center of the spiritual dream.
As the strange powers are swallowed up one after another, the seemingly decayed prison chains are gradually returning to their original appearance. They are all made of fine iron and are the evolution of pure and tenacious faith and will.
In the end, all the strange power emanating from the severed hand was swallowed up by Lu Yu.
And the severed hand that was bound by the chain had completely fallen silent at this time. If it weren't for the faint sense of illusion, one would have thought it was just an ordinary severed hand.
"Hmm~?!"
Looking at the current state of the severed hand, Lu Yu felt a little embarrassed in his heart. Did he suck it too hard?
But no matter what, he completely suppressed the revival of that strange severed hand, right?
With a thought in Lu Yu's mind, the power of fear that had entered Zhang Wei's body and his mental dream instantly retracted and disappeared into his dream world.
And Lu Yu also regained his mind instantly.
In just a moment, Lu Yu took back all his power except for that fear mark.
Looking at Zhang Wei who was in a trance and confused, Lu Yu twitched the corners of his mouth.
He doesn’t know either, ZhangWas Wei looking like this because it was too painful to peel off the weird power from the weird severed hand, or because he had extracted too much weird power.
